description: This file is a test script written in shell script language that tests Git functionalities related to --alternate-refs traversal, including setting up repositories, creating commits, and verifying revision lists and logs with specific options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies their success.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used in test commits to ensure unique commit times.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output, typically failing the test if they differ.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets configuration options for the Git repository for testing purposes.
